description.value: You force your body past its limits through the Force, becoming unable to die from damage or failed death saving throws for the duration. If you reach 0 hit points while the power lasts, you remain conscious and continue to act, though you must make a death saving throw at the start of each of your turns; a failed save imposes a cumulative -1 penalty on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws (including further death saves) until you regain hit points, while a success has no additional effect (a natural 20 still restores 1 hit point). If you are still at 0 hit points when the power ends, you die instantly.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 5
